_comment: Machine-readable registry of every native FFI function exposed by KnotenCore. All functions are invoked via ExternCall { module, function, args } or the equivalent stdlib wrapper. AI agents MUST only call functions listed here — hallucinated names will return ExecResult::Fault at runtime.

modules.registry: WGPU window management, textures, 3D rendering, input, timers, physics
modules.ui: egui immediate-mode GUI (legacy shim + UITextInput buffer)
modules.fs: Filesystem utilities, JSON parsing, array/object helpers
modules.json: JSON serialisation helpers (alias layer over fs module)
modules.math: Trigonometric and arithmetic operations (sin, cos, sqrt, random, ...)

functions.name: registry_play_sound
functions.description: Asynchronously plays a short fire-and-forget sound effect Native PCM file (.wav, .ogg). Guaranteed zero-latency execution. Evaluates the strictly sandboxed allow-read file path logic.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Local path relative to the active execution directory

functions.name: registry_loop_music
functions.description: Asynchronously decodes and loops an infinite background track. Follows strictly sandboxed read paths identically to play_sound.

functions.name: registry_set_volume
functions.description: Sets the global multi-channel volume multiplier. 1.0 is default, 0.0 is mute.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The target volume between 0.0 and 2.0 clamp

functions.name: registry_create_window
functions.description: Bootstraps a WGPU egui window and returns an opaque Handle. This is the preferred window creation path for interactive UI scripts.

functions.name: registry_window_update
functions.description: Pumps the OS event loop and redraws the WGPU frame. Returns Bool(true) while the window is open; false when the user closes it. Call once per loop iteration.

functions.name: registry_window_close
functions.description: Destroys the window and releases its GPU resources from the ARC registry.

functions.name: registry_fill_color
functions.description: Clears the frame buffer to a solid RGB colour (0–255 per channel). Call at the start of each render loop before drawing primitives.

functions.name: registry_texture_load
functions.description: Loads an image file from disk into VRAM and returns a texture Handle. Path must be relative to the working directory.

functions.name: registry_draw_quad_3d
functions.description: Renders a textured quad in 3D world space. Uses geometry caching — vertices computed once per unique scale.

functions.name: registry_draw_sphere
functions.description: Renders a UV-sphere in 3D world space. Geometry is cached per (radius, rings, sectors) combination.

functions.name: registry_draw_cube
functions.description: Renders a textured box in 3D world space.

functions.name: registry_draw_cylinder
functions.description: Renders a textured cylinder in 3D world space.

functions.name: registry_draw_entity
functions.description: Renders an entity in 3D world space.

functions.name: registry_file_create
functions.description: Creates a new file at the given path and returns a writable file Handle. Path must be within the working directory.

functions.name: registry_file_write
functions.description: Appends or writes content to an open file Handle.

functions.name: registry_is_key_pressed
functions.description: Polls the lock-free AtomicBool key table at O(1). Returns Bool(true) if the physical key is currently held. Supported keys: W A S D SPACE UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT.

functions.name: registry_get_mouse_delta_x
functions.description: Returns the horizontal mouse movement delta (Float) since the last frame. Used for FPS camera look.

functions.name: registry_get_mouse_delta_y
functions.description: Returns the vertical mouse movement delta (Float) since the last frame.

functions.name: registry_get_last_char
functions.description: Returns the Unicode codepoint (Int) of the last character typed by the user, or 0 if none.

functions.name: registry_now
functions.description: Captures the current monotonic timestamp and returns a timer Handle. Use with registry_elapsed_ms to measure durations.

functions.name: registry_elapsed_ms
functions.description: Returns the elapsed milliseconds (Int) since the timestamp captured by registry_now.

functions.name: registry_set_camera
functions.description: Configures the global perspective camera with field-of-view and eye position. Affects all subsequent draw calls.

functions.name: registry_dump
functions.description: Returns the total number of live handles in the ARC registry (Int). Useful for diagnosing handle leaks.

functions.name: net_fetch
functions.description: Sends a synchronous HTTP GET request and returns the response body as a String. Requires --allow-net.

functions.name: network_get
functions.description: Performs a synchronous HTTP GET request and returns the response body as a JSON-encoded string (RelType::Str). Sandboxed by --allow-network permission.

functions.name: fs_read_file
functions.description: Reads a file and returns its full content as a String. Path must be relative and within the working directory.

functions.name: fs_parse_json
functions.description: Parses a JSON string into a native KnotenCore value (Object, Array, Int, Float, Bool, or String).

functions.name: json_parse
functions.description: Alias for fs_parse_json. Parses a JSON string into a native KnotenCore value.

functions.name: json_stringify
functions.description: Serialises any KnotenCore value into a JSON string.

functions.name: file_read
functions.description: Reads the entire contents of a file and returns a String. Path is validated via ffi_safety::validate_string and must remain within the working directory. Requires --allow-read.

functions.name: file_write
functions.description: Writes a String to a file, creating it if it does not exist or overwriting it. Returns Bool(true) on success. Path is validated via ffi_safety::validate_string. Requires --allow-write.

functions.name: array_length
functions.description: Returns the length of an Array as Int.

functions.name: array_get
functions.description: Returns the element at index from an Array. Returns Void if index is out of bounds.

functions.name: obj_get
functions.description: Returns the value for a key from an Object map. Returns Void if key is absent.

functions.name: obj_set
functions.description: Returns a new Object with the given key set to the given value (immutable update pattern).

functions.name: obj_has_key
functions.description: Returns Bool(true) if the Object contains the given key.

functions.name: time_sleep_ms
functions.description: Blocks the executor thread for at least the given number of milliseconds. Use for frame pacing (~16ms = 60 FPS cap). No-op if ms <= 0.

functions.name: time_get_string
functions.description: Returns the current local system date and time as a formatted string: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Uses chrono::Local for timezone-aware formatting. Never panics.

functions.name: time_utc_timestamp
functions.description: Returns the current UTC epoch timestamp in seconds as an Int. Uses chrono::Utc::now().timestamp().

functions.name: ui_text_input_get
functions.description: Reads the current value of the global UI_TEXT_INPUT_BUFFER. Returns String. Part of the UITextInput state-binding pattern.

functions.name: ui_text_input_set
functions.description: Overwrites the global UI_TEXT_INPUT_BUFFER. Call to pre-seed a text field before the render loop starts.

functions.name: ui_bar_chart
functions.description: Pushes a native bar chart to the egui render queue. Accepts a String label and an Array of numeric values. Bars are painted with value-proportional heights and floating-point labels.

functions.name: ui_progress_gauge
functions.description: Pushes an animated progress gauge to the egui render queue. Accepts a String label, Float value, Float min, Float max. Rendered via egui::ProgressBar with animation.

functions.name: registry_get_mouse_ray
functions.description: Calculates the Screen-to-World unprojected 3D ray of the mouse cursor relative to the window's view-projection matrix.

functions.name: registry_is_mouse_down
functions.description: Returns true if the user's primary mouse button (left click) is currently pressed.

functions.name: registry_raycast_aabb
functions.description: Performs geometric spatial intersection against all registered global AABBs. Returns the index of the first struck AABB, or -1 if no collision occurs.

functions.name: ui_draw_rect
functions.description: Draws a 2D rectangle to the UI overlay canvas.

functions.name: ui_draw_text
functions.description: Draws 2D text to the UI overlay canvas.

functions.name: ui_present
functions.description: Finalizes the UI drawing queue and presents the UI overlay onto the active window.

functions.name: math_random
functions.description: Generates a random Float uniformly distributed in the range [min, max]. Uses the engine's internal CSPRNG. Strictly enforces Float types — passing Int arguments triggers ExecResult::Fault.

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Lower bound of the random range (inclusive)

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Upper bound of the random range (inclusive)

functions.name: math_vector_scale
functions.description: Multiplies each numeric element in an Array by a scalar factor. Returns a new Array with all elements scaled. Int values are cast to Float in the result.

functions.name: math_matrix_transform
functions.description: Applies a 4x4 transformation matrix (16 floats in column-major order) to a 3D or 4D vector using glam::Mat4. Returns a 4-element Float array (x, y, z, w).

functions.name: registry_destroy_entity
functions.description: Destroys a previously spawned entity (cube, sphere, or cylinder). Removes it from the scene graph and physics world immediately — the entity ceases rendering on the next frame. Does NOT remove shared geometry or texture resources.

parameters.name: entity_id
parameters.description: Entity ID returned by registry_spawn_cube / registry_spawn_sphere / registry_spawn_cylinder

functions.name: registry_force_panic
functions.description: Debug FFI function that intentionally panics inside Rust with 'Simulated core dump from FFI!'. Used to validate the panic-safety layer (Sprint 170). The panic is caught by catch_unwind in machine.rs, the script aborts, but the host application and WGPU render loop continue running.

functions.name: string_len
functions.description: Returns the number of Unicode characters in a string.

functions.name: string_concat
functions.description: Concatenates two strings and returns the result.

functions.name: string_split
functions.description: Splits a string by a delimiter and returns an Array of substrings.

functions.name: string_to_upper
functions.description: Converts all characters in a string to uppercase (UAX-aware).

functions.name: array_push
functions.description: Returns a new Array with the given value appended at the end.

functions.name: array_pop
functions.description: Returns a new Array with the last element removed. No-op on empty arrays.

functions.name: array_len
functions.description: Returns the number of elements in an array.

functions.name: json_parse
functions.description: Parses a JSON string into a native RelType::Object or RelType::Array. Returns Void on parse failure (never crashes the script). Invalid JSON is logged via stderr.

functions.name: json_stringify
functions.description: Serializes a RelType value (Object, Array, String, Number, Bool, Void) into a JSON string. Unserializable types produce '[Unserializable: ...]'.

functions.name: registry_vm_get_ip
functions.description: Returns the current VM instruction pointer. Requires is_inspectable=true on the VM instance. Returns -1 if inspection is disabled.

functions.name: registry_vm_get_stack_depth
functions.description: Returns the current VM operand stack depth. Requires is_inspectable=true on the VM instance. Returns -1 if inspection is disabled.

functions.name: registry_play_tone_panned
functions.description: Plays a synthesised tone with stereo panning on a specified channel. Uses multi-waveform synthesis with ADSR envelope.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Audio channel index (0-N). Replaying on occupied channel stops the old tone.

parameters.name: pan
parameters.description: Stereo pan -1.0 (full left) to 1.0 (full right), 0.0 = center

functions.name: registry_play_tone
functions.description: Plays a synthesized tone on the specified audio channel using default ADSR envelope and zero panning.
